veranderings.blok: Jou kos gee jou die energie
veranderings.rede: The preposition meaning 'after' takes the acute accent (ná) under the AWS, distinguishing it from 'na' meaning 'towards'.

veranderings.voor: Jou kos se energie gaan in alles wat jy doen en in warmte oor.
veranderings.na: Jou kos se energie gaan oor in alles wat jy doen en in warmte.
veranderings.rede: Keeping the separable verb together (gaan oor in) reads more easily than splitting it around a long double phrase; meaning unchanged.
